title.en: MiniMax China API Key Guide: M2.7, Pricing and First Call
title.zh: MiniMax 中国 API Key 指南：M2.7、价格与首次调用

excerpt.en: Use the official MiniMax China key page, compare current M2.7 pay-as-you-go prices, and make a first request with the OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API.
excerpt.zh: 使用 MiniMax 中国官方密钥入口，对比当前 M2.7 按量价格，并通过 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 兼容接口完成首次请求。

heading.en: Official MiniMax China API key page
heading.zh: MiniMax 中国 API Key 官方入口

en: Sign in to https://platform.minimaxi.com and open Account Management → Interface Keys. The direct official key URL is https://platform.minimaxi.com/user-center/basic-information/interface-key. Create a separate key for each application and keep it on the server.
zh: 登录 https://platform.minimaxi.com，进入“账户管理 → 接口密钥”。官方直达地址是 https://platform.minimaxi.com/user-center/basic-information/interface-key。建议每个应用创建独立 Key，并只保存在服务端。

heading.zh: 当前 M2 文本模型

en: MiniMax's current API overview lists M2.7, M2.7-highspeed, M2.5, M2.5-highspeed, M2.1, M2.1-highspeed, and M2. All have a documented 204,800-token input-plus-output window. M2.7 is described at about 60 output tokens per second, while M2.7-highspeed is about 100 TPS.
zh: MiniMax 当前 API 概览列出 M2.7、M2.7-highspeed、M2.5、M2.5-highspeed、M2.1、M2.1-highspeed 与 M2，官方标注输入输出合计窗口均为 204,800 Token。M2.7 输出速度约 60 TPS，M2.7-highspeed 约 100 TPS。

heading.zh: 已核验的文本按量价格

en: Prices below are CNY per million tokens from MiniMax's official pay-as-you-go page, checked August 10, 2026. Audio, image, video and music use separate units and price tables.
zh: 以下价格来自 MiniMax 官方按量计费页，单位为人民币/百万 Token，核验日期为 2026 年 8 月 10 日。语音、图像、视频和音乐采用单独计量方式与价格表。

en: MiniMax-M2.7: input ¥2.1; output ¥8.4; cache read ¥0.42; cache write ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed: input ¥4.2; output ¥16.8; cache read ¥0.42; cache write ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.5: input ¥2.1; output ¥8.4; cache read ¥0.21; cache write ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.5-highspeed: input ¥4.2; output ¥16.8; cache read ¥0.21; cache write ¥2.625
M2-her: input ¥2.1; output ¥8.4; no cache price listed
zh: MiniMax-M2.7：输入 ¥2.1；输出 ¥8.4；缓存读取 ¥0.42；缓存写入 ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed：输入 ¥4.2；输出 ¥16.8；缓存读取 ¥0.42；缓存写入 ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.5：输入 ¥2.1；输出 ¥8.4；缓存读取 ¥0.21；缓存写入 ¥2.625
MiniMax-M2.5-highspeed：输入 ¥4.2；输出 ¥16.8；缓存读取 ¥0.21；缓存写入 ¥2.625
M2-her：输入 ¥2.1；输出 ¥8.4；官方表格未列缓存价格

heading.en: First call with the OpenAI-compatible API
heading.zh: 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口首次调用

en: MiniMax officially supports the OpenAI SDK at https://api.minimaxi.com/v1. The response content can include thinking tags, so preserve the full assistant message in multi-turn conversations.
zh: MiniMax 官方支持在 https://api.minimaxi.com/v1 使用 OpenAI SDK。响应 content 可能包含思考标签，多轮对话中应完整保留 assistant 消息。

codeBlocks.code:
from openai import OpenAI
import os

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["MINIMAX_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://api.minimaxi.com/v1",
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="MiniMax-M2.7",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with: KEY_WORKS"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

caption.en: MiniMax M2.7 with the OpenAI Python SDK
caption.zh: 使用 OpenAI Python SDK 调用 MiniMax M2.7

en: MiniMax also provides an Anthropic-compatible endpoint at https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic and recommends this integration for current text models. It supports text, tool use, tool results and thinking blocks; the compatibility page says image and document inputs are not currently supported.
zh: MiniMax 还提供 https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic 这一 Anthropic 兼容端点，并推荐当前文本模型使用这种接入方式。兼容页说明它支持文本、工具调用、工具结果与 thinking 块，但目前不支持图像和文档输入。

question.en: What is the MiniMax China API base URL?
question.zh: MiniMax 中国 API 的 Base URL 是什么？

answer.en: Use https://api.minimaxi.com/v1 for the OpenAI SDK or https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic for the Anthropic SDK.
answer.zh: OpenAI SDK 使用 https://api.minimaxi.com/v1；Anthropic SDK 使用 https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic。

question.en: How large is the M2.7 context window?

answer.en: MiniMax documents a 204,800-token combined input and output window.
answer.zh: MiniMax 官方标注输入和输出合计为 204,800 Token。

question.zh: M2.7-highspeed 的模型质量不同吗？

answer.en: MiniMax describes it as the same capability with faster output, approximately 100 TPS instead of approximately 60 TPS, and prices it at twice the standard input/output rate.
answer.zh: MiniMax 将其描述为能力不变但输出更快，约 100 TPS 而非约 60 TPS；输入与输出价格是标准版的两倍。
